items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer asks 'were you there with Mickey Cohen' and mentions Cohen took over the Rum Boogie, but the interviewee (Paul L. Howard) does not confirm personal interaction or a professional relationship with Cohen in the provided text.

ctx.x: Rum Boogie was C. P. Johnson.
That's right, were you there with Mickey Cohen.
